pdfExport.title: Export PDF
pdfExport.previewNote: Pagination and layout are done by the browser — use Print… to preview.
pdfExport.headerHint: Header shows the title, footer the page number — for “Save as PDF” only; printing uses the system dialog.
pdfExport.backgroundsHint: Turn this off and code blocks and table headers become plain white
pdfExport.colorHint: Color prints exactly what you see (theme and custom CSS included); black & white keeps every lightness and only drops the colour.
pdfExport.overflowedHint: One block is taller than a page and cannot be split, so that page is stretched — the real page count may be higher.
pdfExport.paperHint: Printing uses the system dialog — paper comes from the printer

styles.title: Interface styles
styles.hint: custom.css is always on. Other .css files in the same folder are off by default — turn one on globally in the Styles panel on the right, or bind it to a single open file. Save a change and it takes effect within about two seconds.
styles.empty: No stylesheets in the folder yet.
styles.lockedHint: Always on: this is the main stylesheet. Rename the file to get rid of it.
styles.fileHint: What you turn on here applies to this file only — another file gets a different set.
styles.noFile: No file is open. Open one to bind stylesheets to it.
styles.reloadHint: Fallback for edits made in an external editor
